what_this_is: A dated comparison of each club's officially published depth chart against that club's officially published transactions log. A row is flagged stale when the chart names a player whom the log placed on reserve with no later activation. Nothing is corrected: both sources are published as they stand.
rule: match on the full normalised name; decide on the most recent dated transaction that names the player
known_limits: Only clubs whose transactions page was captured are compared; the rest are listed with no comparison rather than assumed clean.
A transaction that says 'Signed QB X' does not establish that X replaced the injured starter, so no replacement is named.
The Indianapolis capture holds November and late-September entries only; the log is complete for November and incomplete before it.
A depth chart is a club opinion with no expiry; the newest capture is used and its fetch time is published with every row.
